scenario: Search invoices by PO number and add two lines from different invoices to one request
expected_result: Both lines appear in one request

scenario: Enter a quantity above what is still returnable
expected_result: Rejected, with the returnable quantity shown

scenario: Add a stock item, 12 days old, reason "ordered the wrong part"
expected_result: Eligible, 15% fee, customer pays freight

scenario: Add an item 45 days old
expected_result: Shown as outside the window, exception offered

scenario: Add a cut-to-length hose
expected_result: Shown as non-returnable, exception offered

scenario: Submit a transit damage return with no photo
expected_result: Blocked until a photo is attached

scenario: Submit a warranty claim
expected_result: Failure description and install date are required

scenario: Submit a request where every line meets the automatic rule
expected_result: RMA and packing slip shown within 10 seconds

scenario: Submit a Tessmar-error return worth $18
expected_result: No shipment asked for, status Approved, credit follows

scenario: Approve a return where Tessmar pays freight
expected_result: Prepaid label available to print

scenario: Receive a return at the warehouse
expected_result: Requester emailed within 15 minutes, status Received

scenario: Leave an approved RMA unshipped for 14 and then 21 days
expected_result: Reminder at day 14, status Expired at day 21

scenario: Submit a $900 line and work it from the queue
expected_result: Appears in queue with reason "over $500", approval issues the RMA

scenario: Deny a line without entering a reason
expected_result: Blocked until a reason is entered

scenario: Coordinator approves a $6,200 request
expected_result: Goes to the sales manager, no RMA until they approve

scenario: Sales manager waives the fee on one line
expected_result: Expected credit recalculated, waiver stored with name and reason

scenario: Scan an RMA and record 3 received of 5 expected
expected_result: Shortage shown, credit based on 3

scenario: Log a package that has no RMA
expected_result: Appears in the coordinator's queue as unidentified

scenario: Complete inspection on a line with a 15% fee, restocked at full value
expected_result: Draft credit memo in ERP for 85% of line value within 5 minutes

scenario: Adjust a draft amount and post
expected_result: Reason required, ERP document number stored, customer emailed

scenario: Rep enters a return for an assigned account, then searches for an unassigned one
expected_result: First succeeds and records the rep, second cannot be opened

scenario: Mark two lines from one supplier "return to supplier" and record a claim number
expected_result: Grouped under the supplier, claim number on both returns

scenario: Filter the dashboard by reason and group by part number
expected_result: Counts match the test data, export matches the screen

scenario: Take the ERP test system offline, submit a request, bring it back
expected_result: Request accepted, transactions queued and then posted (NFR-04)
